title: Validate E170 GUI backup restore
changes: Document the actual E170 GUI backup restore over different synthetic save bytes, followed by Bank slot load and replay in isolated raw and managed sessions.
validation: Wine/Xvfb xssda1xe PASS: five equal state and clock endpoints, backup and copied slot unchanged, 46 aggregate managed range bytes, guarded inputs, normal GUI exits, Wine drained and scratch removed.
limitations: Sentinel checked before paused menu navigation; endpoint comparisons only, no per-frame video/audio, real-time play, personal save, native Windows, other scenes or mods. Native dispatch may fall back. Wine logged transient access-denied and D-Bus assertion; earlier 49yki2lw and caqte4ns stopped on driver assumptions.
